function.name: inspect_structure
function.description: Inspect the committed AGE_BY_ID function, arrays, nested control flow and current revision.

function.name: discover_symbols
function.description: Discover function, parameter, array, loop and assignment symbols with their live opaque IDs.

function.name: inspect_statements
function.description: List typed assignment statements, targets, indices, values, nesting paths and statement IDs.

function.name: inspect_references
function.description: Inspect references to a symbol discovered from discover_symbols.

function.name: preview_age_edit
function.description: Ask the mission gateway to preview changing one discovered assignment to a finite age in [0,130]. Preview does not commit.

function.name: commit_age_edit
function.description: Commit a transaction returned by a successful preview; gateway rechecks revision, scope and full semantic delta.

function.name: run_lookup_checks
function.description: Run the host's fixed AGE_BY_ID oracle under both MIR engines; this does not mutate the program.
